title: Formal ratio of infinity; proper to God alone
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Ye formal in ye negation belonging toward a term consists, which both any perfection belonging toward a being with ye precision belonging toward ye other perfections is, plus any grade belonging toward perfection with ye precision belonging toward ye remaining grades. But this property so unto God belongs that in none belonging toward ye creatures it is found, because every creature necessarily from God ye fountain belonging toward every perfection a certain plus definite number belonging toward perfections, plus of all of them a definite plus limited grade, takes.
pass_b_english: The formal consists in the negation of a term, which is both any perfection of a being with the precision of the other perfections, and any grade of perfection with the precision of the remaining grades. But this property so belongs to God that it is found in none of the creatures, because every creature necessarily takes from God the fountain of every perfection a certain and definite number of perfections, and of all of them a definite and limited grade.
source_text: Formale consistit in negatione termini, qui est, tum quaelibet entis perfectio, cum praecisione caeterarum perfectionum, tum quilibet perfectionis gradus, cum praecisione reliquorum graduum. Haec vero proprietas ita Deo convenit, ut in nulla creaturarum inveniatur, quia omnis creatura necessario certum definitumque perfectionum numerum, earumque omnium definitum ac limitatum gradum a Deo omnis perfectionis fonte capit.
